title: Legacy Freedom Unlimited Plan (2018 Grandfathered)
data_allowance: Unlimited 4G LTE on-device data; subject to network deprioritization during cell congestion after 22GB
tethering_hotspot: Strict 10GB high-speed mobile hotspot limit per billing cycle; hard cutoff upon reaching 10GB with zero rollover. Additional hotspot requires $15/5GB legacy add-on.
roaming_included: Domestic voice and text only; international roaming billed at standard pay-per-use rates ($2.05/MB, $0.50/min)
grandfathered_notes: Contractual lock: Customers retaining this plan cannot transfer tethering quota to another line and cannot receive modern 5G hotspot allowances without full migration to 5G Ultra Max.
